issues_found.description: TC-SPT-04-04 invokes dropTestTenantSchema explicitly (not via `defer`). On the failure path before the drop (e.g. a schema_before/ts_before assertion fails), the provisioned schema would leak. Post-run state confirms no leak in practice, but wrapping the drop in `defer` would make the failure path leak-free. Recommend a follow-up hardening; does not block PASS.

SPT-04 AC1 broad suite rework (the ~118 legacy-model tests/integration/ files — adp02/adp03/env*/par06/pin01/prm01/svc04 etc.) is a documented follow-up SPT batch per SECURITY-REVIEWER Step 2c and design OQ-1 precedent.
